tables.name: metadata
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: roles
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE roles(user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, active INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    granted_by TEXT NOT NULL, at_utc TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: role_audit
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE role_audit(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, actor TEXT NOT NULL,
                    subject TEXT NOT NULL, before_active INTEGER, after_active INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    at_utc TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: revisions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE revisions(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INTEGER,
                    token TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, personnel_id TEXT,
                    effective_from TEXT, effective_to TEXT, before_json TEXT, after_json TEXT,
                    at_utc TEXT NOT NULL, people BLOB NOT NULL, assignments BLOB NOT NULL,
                    extra_rules TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: proposals
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE proposals(token TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                    actor TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, base_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL, at_utc TEXT NOT NULL, expires_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
                    committed_revision INTEGER, policy_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: immutable_revision_update
tables.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_revision_update BEFORE UPDATE ON revisions
                    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_REVISION'); END

tables.name: immutable_revision_delete
tables.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_revision_delete BEFORE DELETE ON revisions
                    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_REVISION'); END

tables.name: users
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE users(user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, role TEXT NOT NULL,
                    active INTEGER NOT NULL, approved_by TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: state
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE state(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: inbox
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE inbox(update_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    handled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

tables.name: jobs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE jobs(job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, update_id INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                    user_id TEXT NOT NULL, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL, file_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    original_name TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT, error TEXT,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: outbox
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE outbox(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    event_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL,
                    job_id TEXT, document TEXT, sha256 TEXT, keyboard TEXT,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', receipt TEXT, error TEXT,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: audit
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event TEXT NOT NULL,
                    actor TEXT, subject TEXT, at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: personnel_ui_sessions
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE personnel_ui_sessions(user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: personnel_ui_events
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE personnel_ui_events(update_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, response TEXT NOT NULL)
